chunks: Whoever performs wudu (ablution) and mentions the name of Allah, his entire body becomes pure, and the wudu from one wudu to the next is an expiation for the sins between them. And whoever does not mention [the name of Allah] will not become pure from his body except that which the water touches.

key_terms.كَفَّارَةً: an expiation that wipes away sins
key_terms.ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ: the name of Allah, mentioned at the time of wudu
key_terms.ٱلذُّنُوبِ: sins committed between the two acts of wudu
key_terms.ٱلْوُضُوءُ: wudu (ablution), the ritual washing before worship

ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of mentioning the name of Allah during wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith states that mentioning the name of Allah during wudu (ablution) brings purification to the whole body. It also describes wudu as an expiation for sins committed between one ablution and the next, while indicating that without tasmiyah, purification is limited to the places reached by water.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: 'Whoever performs ablution and mentions the name of Allah (swt), all of his body becomes pure, and the ablution performed between two ablutions serves as atonement for the sins committed between them. And whoever does not mention [the name of Allah (swt)] will not purify his body except for what the water touches.'"
